_comment: ruby#421 -- the engine-compat manifest. Every release train updates the pairings as it rides; tools/check_engine_compat.py verifies the manifest against the live registries in CI (tag <-> engine_commit, crates, npm, rubygems, pypi). Runtime versions follow the engine-linked scheme {engine-semver}.{runtime-single-digit} (npm: the engine semver, the 4th segment is invalid there) -- the leptris precedent. The rubygems/npm entries follow the current train's actual spellings (1.5.12, 3-segment).
